rv.q: This is a potent story, told with imagination and flair.
The three actors create wholly believable and, perhaps more surprisingly, very 21st century characters.
But if you’re going to make a short story a two-and-a-half-hour play, it’s going to need more subtext, less exposition.

cn.t: This Australian adaptation returns to Isaac Bashevis Singer's original story rather than Streisand's musical, earning mixed reviews for its theatrical richness but uneven execution.
